errors: put-vs-load race not actually closed: loader does inflight.remove(key, mine) and then install() takes the lock separately; a put landing between those two steps is overwritten by the older loaded value, contradicting the stated guarantee
Window between loader's inflight.remove and install lets a concurrent miss start a second load (duplicate DB call, not a correctness bug)
A.note: Clean, well-argued single-lock design with executor-based single-flight, but the claimed put-wins guarantee has a real race because inflight removal and install are not under the same lock.

errors: Miss check (under lock) and inflight.putIfAbsent are not atomic: a load that completes in between lets a second caller start another load, so the stated 'one load per missing key' guarantee is slightly overstated

B.note: Correct and careful (put and install both under the lock, expired-first eviction via a heap with lazy stale refs), slightly heavier than needed.

errors: No timeout on waiters' join; a hung DB call pins all waiters (minor)
